title: Worker 06 bounded source identity review and isolated proposals

reviewer.identity: Codex worker06 /root with research_a, research_b, research_c; actual author/reviewer scopes in agent-scopes.json
reviewer.independence_basis: This is the team-authored native synthesis. Separate skeptical reviews are durable evidence: root reviewed A47; A reviewed B47; B reviewed C51; C reviewed root43. Integration review is distinct from B science approval.

summary: All 188 frozen source cases have an evidence-backed assessment and separate skeptical review after primary-source research; unavailable primary recipes remain explicit in primary-access-limitations.json; 100 exact isolated proposals are represented. Review completion does not assert all identities resolved. Maintained sources and all source/owner/export holds remain unchanged.

scope.description: Bounded supplied-substance, formulation, alias, mapping and source-occurrence assessment; inherited full-owner roles and downstream publication are outside this review.
scope.selection: Exact frozen shard06 cases plus each final unique proposed owner payload; no other worker cases are scientifically claimed.

exclusions.reason: Read-only collision routing is not their scientific review.

exclusions.target: Full maintained owner payload release and downstream exports
exclusions.reason: Coordinator integration requires fresh content-bound native approval after guarded edits; no release approval is conferred here.
